lower_description: soft powdery wood ash bed, a warm mid-light grey with a brown cast, mottled #8a867d #aaa49a and a little #6a6865, small drifts and soft footprints, a few charred black flecks, never blue or slate, calm low contrast
upper_description: soot-blackened bare earth like the ground under a doused bonfire, smudged grey soot over dark brown dirt, an even mix of soot grey #4f4e52 #3a3a3e and burnt brown #553a26, charcoal dust, one continuous soft surface, no cracks, no rocks, no stones, no plates, no slabs, no cobbles
